name: Encryption & Transport Security
description: Ensures all data transmitted by agents uses strong encryption and secure transport protocols. Validates TLS version, cipher strength, and certificate validity for all outbound connections. Enforces encryption requirements for stored sensitive data.
threat_addressed: Agent communications traversing untrusted networks without encryption expose sensitive data to interception, tampering, and man-in-the-middle attacks. Weak or deprecated cryptographic protocols provide false sense of security while remaining vulnerable to known attacks.
enforcement_mechanism: Validates transport security for outbound agent actions — TLS version, cipher suite, certificate validity. Enforces minimum encryption standards based on data classification. Blocks connections using deprecated protocols (SSL 3.0, TLS 1.0/1.1).

security_outcome.pass: Data encrypted in transit using approved protocols and cipher suites.
security_outcome.fail: Insufficient encryption or deprecated transport protocol detected.

display_detail: Validates encryption and transport security for all agent communications and data storage.
remediation_hint_template: Transport security insufficient. Ensure all agent connections use TLS 1.2+ with strong cipher suites.
